Your role @ Chanel
Within the Global Corporate Information Security (GISEC) Team, your mission is to help bridge Business and Technology to facilitate the adoption of various security initiatives aiming to reduce Cyber risks to an appropriate level across the CHANEL organization. You will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in managing changes to information security processes and solutions within a dynamic international environment.
You'll be part of an experienced and driven team specializing in transformation, committed to supporting your growth journey and ensuring your mission's success.
The impact you can create at Chanel
Cyber-Transformation roadmap delivery officer:
To ensure the efficient execution of the Chanel-wide Transformation roadmap, you will assist the Transformation team with the day-to-day follow-up and delivery of a specific list of projects and run activities. Your support will include the following activities:
• Maintain project/run activity dashboards, KPIs, governance materials, and documentation to provide accurate project visibility or coordinate with project leads to maintain consistent and standardized data and reporting processes.
• Participate in workshops and governance meetings.
• Support project/run activity planning, coordination, and delivery.
• Track actions progress, milestones, risks, and dependencies with identified key stakeholders from global and local teams.
• Contribute to the project/run activity data analysis, reporting, and quality assurance.
• Identify and implement improvements to streamline tracking and reporting.
Example of projects/run activities part of the roadmap that you might support are:
• SAIA, project aiming at simplifying and automating further the multiples security assessments applicable to an application.
• PCI-DSS remediation, project aiming at oversighting the remediation of a key global application to meet PCI-DSS requirements.
• Data Leakage Prevention (DLP) Governance. This activity aims to ensure a coordinated and structured approach for the new DLP controls to be implemented, review of the DLP metrics and incidents, etc.
• Transformation and GISEC Portfolio Management: The activity aims to provide up to date insights to Transformation and GISEC management to pilot their scope.
In addition, you will play a key role in the team as a Cyber-Transformation engagement & Delivery Excellence agent
• Support the onboarding of new joiners into the Transformation team from a logistic to operational aspects.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Cyber Transformation Project and Change management frameworks and supporting toolkits. Support the socialisation and adoption of such artefacts across the GISEC community.
• Contribute to the regular update of the GISEC and Cyber Transformation transversal dashboards, reporting, governance and communication materials and platforms (e.g., Intranet).
• Provide ad hoc PMO and operational assistance across evolving Transformation priorities, ensuring alignment between initiatives and delivery timelines.
What you will bring
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Communications, Project Management, or related fields
• Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
• Strong written and verbal communication skills​, with attention to details
• Knowledge in information security principles, concepts, and best practices.
• Knowledge in project management appreciated
• Ability to prioritize workloads, multitask and organize work in a timely manner
• Ability to drive your own projects to a high standard proactively, as well as work with the wider team
• Quick learner with a positive attitude, professional demeanor, ability to communicate concisely with both functional and technical experts
• Ability to work autonomously when required
• Customer-oriented
• English is a must; French is a plus.​
Benefits:
• Gain hands-on experience in a real-world IT environment
• Opportunity to contribute to meaningful IT projects that impact the organization's success
• Networking opportunities with IT team members and professionals across the company
• Exposure to a Cyber Security & Project Management
Start: September 2026
Duration: 12 months.
Location: London
At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to Chanel.

Helping others improve and turn their lives around – there’s no better feeling. It’s what we do for thousands of people at more than 150 sites across the UK. Be a part of it.
Support Worker
Cygnet Nield House, Crewe, Cheshire
Location: Cygnet Nield House, Barrows Green, Bradfield Road, Crewe, Cheshire, CW1 4QW
Salary: £13.15 per hour rising to £13.70 after 3 months
Hours: 42 hours per week across a mixed shift pattern (12 hour day and night shifts)
Ideal for: Candidates with care experience or transferable skills from people-focused roles.
Excited to grow your career?
Are you looking for a rewarding Support Worker job in Crewe where you can use your experience, people skills and compassion to make a real difference?
At Cygnet, our people make all the difference. We value talented, committed colleagues and, wherever possible, support our teams to grow professionally and develop their careers.
We are looking for confident, compassionate and resilient Support Workers with a passion for delivering outstanding care to join our team at Cygnet Nield House in Crewe.
You’ll be working 42 hours per week across a mixed 12-hour shift pattern, helping to make a positive difference to the lives of the women in our care.
Whether you have experience in care, mental health, healthcare, support work or residential services, or you bring transferable skills from roles such as customer service, hospitality, retail, education, security, community work or family caring responsibilities, this could be the next step in your career.
About Cygnet Nield House
Cygnet Nield House is a specialist mental health hospital for women in Crewe, Cheshire. The service supports women aged 18 and over and is split into two distinct wards, each offering specialist mental health care.
Clarion Ward
Clarion Ward is a 14-bed complex personality disorder service for women with a dual diagnosis of personality disorder, with or without co-morbid disordered eating.
Compton Ward
Compton Ward is a 15-bed acute service for women. The ward provides a safe and stabilising environment for women experiencing an acute episode of mental illness who require an emergency admission.
At Nield House, you’ll be part of a supportive, multidisciplinary team helping women feel safe, respected and empowered as they work towards recovery, independence and improved wellbeing.
A role where your experience matters
This role is ideal for someone who already has some experience supporting people, or who has developed strong transferable skills in another people-focused environment.
You may have worked as a:
• Support Worker
• Healthcare Assistant
• Mental Health Support Worker
• Care Assistant
• Residential Support Worker
• Recovery Worker
• Teaching Assistant
• Youth Worker
• Customer Service Advisor
• Hospitality or retail colleague
• Security Officer
• Community volunteer
• Family carer
If you are calm under pressure, a good communicator and passionate about helping people, we can support you to build a meaningful career in health and social care.
Your Day-to-Day
As a Support Worker at Cygnet Nield House, you’ll provide practical, emotional and therapeutic support to women with mental health needs.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Offering enhanced care using a flexible, person-centred approach
• Providing guidance and encouragement through physical and emotional support
• Building positive, professional and trusting relationships with service users
• Learning about each individual’s specific needs and supporting them in the most appropriate way
• Assisting with medical and welfare needs
• Reporting medical and welfare concerns as required
• Supporting safeguarding practices and maintaining professional boundaries
• Helping to maintain a safe, clean and therapeutic environment
• Encouraging independence, confidence and positive daily routines
• Working closely with nurses, clinicians and wider colleagues to deliver outstanding care
You Are...
We are looking for people who are genuinely driven to make a difference.
• Caring, confident and compassionate
• Experienced in care or able to bring strong transferable skills
• A clear communicator and good team player
• Sensitive, intuitive and respectful
• Calm, patient and resilient
• Passionate about empowering women and supporting independence
• Able to work positively in a mental health hospital environment
• Motivated to learn, develop and grow your career with Cygnet
You do not need to have worked in a mental health hospital before, but some experience of supporting people, working with challenging situations or helping others through difficult moments would be beneficial.
Why Cygnet?
At Cygnet, we support our people to grow their careers, gain new skills and keep stepping up.
• Salary of £13.15 to £13.70 per hour
• Full-time hours, 42 hours per week
• Mixed 12-hour shift pattern
• Flexible working with opportunity for overtime
• Regular coaching and appraisal
• Expert supervision and peer support
• Employee discount savings
• Cycle to Work scheme
• Recruitment referral scheme
• Wellbeing centre with exercises, recipes, financial advice and mental health support
• The opportunity to build a rewarding career in mental health care
• A supportive team environment where your work makes a real difference
Frequently Asked Questions
Where is Cygnet Nield House located?
Cygnet Nield House is located at Barrows Green, Bradfield Road, Crewe, Cheshire, CW1 4QW.
What type of service is Cygnet Nield House?
Cygnet Nield House is a specialist mental health hospital for women, offering acute mental health support and complex personality disorder services.
Do I need previous care experience?
Some experience in care, healthcare, support work or mental health would be helpful, but we are also interested in candidates with transferable skills from people-focused roles.

Useful transferable skills include communication, empathy, resilience, teamwork, patience, problem-solving, remaining calm under pressure and supporting people through challenging situations.
What hours will I work?
You’ll work 42 hours per week across a mixed shift pattern of 12-hour shifts.
How much does the role pay?
The salary is £13.15 rising to £13.70 per hour after 3 months.
Is this a good role for someone local to Crewe?
Yes. This is a great opportunity for candidates looking for Support Worker jobs in Crewe, mental health jobs in Cheshire, or a full-time care role in the local area.
Ready to grow your career?
If you care about making a difference, we want to talk to you.
Join Cygnet Nield House in Crewe as a Support Worker and help women with mental health needs feel safe, supported and empowered.
Apply now and start making a difference with Cygnet.

Management Level
F
EQ Retirement Solutions is transforming the retirement and pensions markets with leading administration and technology solutions. With over 1200 employees globally, 189 years of knowledge and 11 million pension scheme members and policyholders, we are here to help people plan for a confident financial future by delivering innovative, reliable and customer-focused retirement services. Our teams are driven by a shared commitment to excellence, collaboration and making a real impact to the lives of our clients and customers.
Role Summary
EQ Retirement Solutions is looking for an HR Business Partner on a 12-month fixed term contract to support a significant period of business change. This role will be hybrid to our Crawley office.
The purpose of this role is to partner with business leaders to deliver commercially focused people solutions that support organisational performance, employee engagement and business objectives. In addition to providing broad HR Business Partner support across the employee lifecycle, the role will play a key role in supporting the separation of EQ Retirement Solutions from Equiniti Group, alongside the delivery of day-to-day operational and strategic people initiatives.
Core Duties/Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
• Partner with leaders and managers to translate the People strategy into practical plans and actions aligned with business objectives.
• Provide proactive HR support and challenge to leaders on organisational, people and workforce matters.
• Support the delivery of the EQ Retirement Solutions separation programme, including organisational design, employee transitions and people-related change activities.
• Act as a key People lead on TUPE projects, consultation activity and employee transfer arrangements.
• Support and advise managers through organisational change, restructuring and workforce planning initiatives.
• Lead and support complex employee relations matters, including disciplinaries, grievances, absence management, redundancies and settlement discussions.
• Support cyclical People activities including performance reviews, talent planning, succession planning, annual pay reviews and bonus processes.
• Drive employee engagement initiatives and support leaders in developing and delivering action plans arising from employee feedback.
• Coach, support and develop managers to strengthen people management capability and leadership effectiveness.
• Work with managers to identify people trends, workforce risks and opportunities using HR data and analytics.
• Produce and present people metrics, insights and board reporting to support informed decision-making.
• Partner with Resourcing, Reward, Learning & Development and People Services colleagues to ensure an integrated approach to people management.
• Support business cases, change programmes, acquisitions, disposals and other strategic business initiatives where required.
• Ensure People policies, practices and decisions are applied consistently and in line with employment legislation and company standards.
• Champion a positive, inclusive and high-performing culture across EQ Retirement Solutions.
The duties and responsibilities outlined above are to be regarded as broad areas of responsibility and do not necessarily detail all tasks which the post holder may be required to perform.
Skills, Capabilities and Attributes
The ideal candidate will have the below skills, capabilities and attributes
• Significant HR Business Partnering experience within a commercial organisation.
• Strong HR generalist knowledge across employee relations, organisational design, talent management, engagement, reward and workforce planning.
• Demonstrable experience supporting organisational change, consultation exercises and TUPE transfers.
• Experience of managing complex employee relations cases and providing pragmatic, commercially focused advice.
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility quickly at senior leadership level.
• Excellent coaching and facilitation skills.
• Experience of analysing workforce data and translating insights into meaningful actions and recommendations.
• Strong understanding of UK employment legislation and HR best practice.
• Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and HR systems, including Workday.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within a fast-paced environment.
• Highly organised, responsive and resilient, with strong attention to detail.
Preferred
• Experience supporting business separations, carve-outs, mergers or acquisitions.
• Experience within pensions, financial services or another regulated environment.
• Experience working within a unionised environment.
• CIPD Level 5 or Level 7 qualification (or equivalent).
• Experience supporting large-scale organisational transformation and change programmes.
• Knowledge of project management principles and change methodologies.
What We Offer
• Save For Your Future - Equiniti Pension Plan; Equiniti matches your pension contributions up to 10%
• Health and Wellbeing – Employee Assistance Programme: counselling, legal & wellbeing support for colleagues and their households. Life assurance cover at 4x salary with the ability to purchase enhance cover.
• Employee discounts – Discounts and cashback at your favourite high street stores through our EQ Wins Platform.
• Flexible Benefits – The ability to purchase a wide variety of benefits through our flex plan; gadgets, travel insurance, will writing, holiday trading and more.

• Winning together – Equiniti ICON award vouchers; recognising the individuals going above and beyond to help the business succeed.
• Learning & Development – Investment in LinkedIn Learning for all colleagues.

We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

Company:
Marsh
Description:
The Head of Cyber Reinsurance Actuarial leads the actuarial function supporting cyber reinsurance broking and advisory at Marsh Re. This role is accountable for developing and maintaining cyber actuarial analytics, translating model outputs into actionable placement and portfolio insights, and partnering with broking, analytics, and advisory teams to deliver high-quality client and market solutions.
We will count on you to:
• Own the actuarial strategy for cyber projects aligning analytics to placement needs and client objectives.
• Lead cyber pricing and portfolio analytics, including experience analysis, exposure/rate adequacy views, and scenario and stress testing to support structuring and negotiation.
• Develop and oversee actuarial methodologies for cyber (frequency/severity, tail risk, aggregation, systemic/catastrophe-style events), including model governance, assumptions, and limitations documentation.
• Translate technical results into clear client-facing insights and materials for submissions, renewals, and stewardship reviews (e.g., key drivers, sensitivities, uncertainty ranges).
• Partner closely with broking to support market strategy, reinsurer engagement, and deal execution; provide actuarial support in negotiations where needed.
• Establish strong peer review and quality controls for actuarial work products, consistent with professional standards and internal governance expectations for analytics work. Build and manage a high-performing cyber actuarial team (hiring, coaching, development, workload prioritisation), fostering a culture of technical excellence and commercial impact.
• Contribute to thought leadership (market insights, benchmarking, and research) that supports the firm’s cyber positioning with clients and reinsurers.
What you need to have:
• Qualified actuary (FIA/FCAS/FSA or equivalent), with significant post-qualification experience in (re)insurance pricing and portfolio analytics.
• Prior experience in cyber (re)insurance, including cyber pricing and portfolio analytics and/or cyber tail risk/aggregation/systemic risk considerations.
• Demonstrated expertise in building and governing actuarial models and methodologies, including documentation of assumptions, limitations, and uncertainty.
• Proven ability to translate complex technical outputs into clear, client-ready insights and commercially actionable recommendations for placements and portfolio strategy.
What makes you stand out?
• Strong understanding of reinsurance structuring and the broking lifecycle, with credibility in supporting negotiations and reinsurer engagement.
• Thought leadership track record (market insights, benchmarking, research, or external speaking/publishing) in cyber or specialty (re)insurance analytics.
• Experience leading and developing high-performing teams, including hiring, coaching, and setting quality/peer review standards.
Why join our team:
• We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
• We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
• Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We are proud to hold ISFM Cat-Friendly Clinic Gold status, reflecting our commitment to ensuring our feline patients receive the highest standards of care.
We believe in supporting and investing in our people, offering opportunities to gain additional qualifications alongside a structured programme of career progression within our wider group.
Our excellent night team is dedicated to providing outstanding care for our medical and surgical inpatients. With our out-of-hours service operating from 10 pm on weekdays and 6 pm at weekends, our team can focus on delivering the high standard of overnight nursing care we strive for.
Your role and responsibilities
As an Out-of-Hours RVN, you will be a key member of our nursing team, working closely with the Lead OOH RVN and OOH Patient Care Assistants to provide exceptional nursing care to a varied range of medical and surgical cases.
Your role will involve monitoring and caring for hospitalised patients overnight, recognising changes in their condition and working collaboratively with the veterinary team to ensure each patient receives the care they need.
In the evenings, you will liaise with our ward RVN and veterinary surgeon to develop appropriate overnight nursing plans, ensuring continuity of care for every patient. In the mornings, you will provide a comprehensive handover to the day team, sharing important updates on patient progress, treatments and ongoing care requirements.
We encourage our RVNs to contribute their knowledge and professional opinions when discussing cases. Understanding each patient's clinical history, presenting condition and reason for hospitalisation is essential, and we believe your clinical judgement and nursing expertise should be valued and encouraged.
This is an excellent opportunity for an RVN who enjoys the clinical responsibility of inpatient nursing and wants to develop their skills while working alongside an experienced and supportive out-of-hours team.
The role follows a 7 nights on, 14 nights off rota, working from 6:30 pm to 7:30 am. This pattern offers an attractive work-life balance, giving you extended periods away from work while allowing you to make a valuable contribution to the care of our patients overnight.
In return, we offer a competitive salary that reflects the importance of our nursing team, alongside a comprehensive benefits package and opportunities for ongoing professional development.
Benefits

• Wellness programme, including Employee Assistance Programme, eyecare voucher scheme, free annual flu jab, cycle to work scheme and more

We're looking for a self-motivated and customer-focused engineer with excellent technical knowledge and a commitment to delivering outstanding service.

• Proven experience maintaining and repairing heavy construction plant, with strong knowledge of diesel engines, hydraulics, drivetrains, electrics, and diagnostic systems.
• Advanced fault-finding and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently in a field-based environment.
• Strong communication and customer service skills, with the confidence to build effective working relationships.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close this advert early should sufficient suitable applications be received. Early applications are therefore encouraged.

Our way of working as a professional community, can be best described as Caring, Daring and Sharing. Caring because we are service-minded, and we always like to go the extra mile for our customers and give our people the attention and care they deserve. Daring because we are innovative in our business, constantly looking for smart improvement. And finally Sharing because we realize we’re doing this together; with our clients, with a great team of skilled specialists, excellent manufacturers and reliable suppliers. General

Job Title
Senior Manager, Prudential Risk
Job Description
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in
established businesses.
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG – the future gets built here
Your Team:
This is a technically demanding, high-visibility role at the core of IG's second line of defence. As Senior Manager, Prudential Risk, you will be IG's in-house expert on capital adequacy and prudential regulation — owning the ICARA process end-to-end and ensuring IG's regulatory submissions to the FCA meet the highest standards of rigour.
Working in close partnership with Finance and the wider Risk function, you will translate complex regulatory requirements into well-governed capital planning processes. This is a role for a rare combination: quantitative capability, regulatory fluency, and the credibility to engage confidently with the FCA, senior management, and Board-level committees.
What you'll do:
ICARA Process Execution
• Own and execute IG's Internal Capital Adequacy and Risk Assessment (ICARA) process end-to-end, coordinating risk assessments, wind-down analysis, and capital and liquidity adequacy assessments across the Group.
• Design and run stress testing programmes that credibly challenge IG's capital position under a range of macroeconomic, market, and idiosyncratic scenarios.
• Produce the ICARA document to a standard that withstands FCA scrutiny, incorporating clear narrative, robust quantitative analysis, and well-evidenced conclusions.
• Drive continuous improvement of the ICARA methodology, embedding lessons from regulatory feedback and evolving best practice.
Capital Modelling & Quantitative Methodology
• Develop and maintain IG's capital models, covering Pillar 1 own funds requirements, Pillar 2 add-ons, and operational risk capital quantification.
• Build and refine quantitative risk methodologies, including scenario analysis frameworks, tail loss modelling, and sensitivity analysis tools.
• Maintain model documentation to the standard required for internal governance and regulatory review, ensuring assumptions, limitations, and calibration are clearly articulated.
• Monitor MIFIDPRU developments and FCA thematic reviews, assessing implications for IG's capital models and ensuring methodologies remain current.
Regulatory Submissions & Engagement
• Prepare regulatory submissions and associated documentation for FCA requirements, including ICARA submissions, regulatory returns, and responses to supervisory requests.
• Act as subject matter expert during regulatory examinations and thematic reviews, presenting IG's capital assessment approach with clarity and authority.
• Draft IG's responses to FCA consultations relevant to prudential regulation, identifying practical implications and setting out well-reasoned positions.
• Maintain current knowledge of MIFIDPRU, CRD/CRR developments, and FCA supervisory priorities, translating requirements into actionable internal guidance.
Capital Planning & Finance Partnership
• Partner closely with Finance on capital planning, forecasting, and ongoing monitoring, ensuring risk and finance perspectives are well integrated in IG's capital management process.
• Produce regular capital adequacy MI for Risk Committee and Board, providing clear analysis of headroom, sensitivities, and emerging risks to the capital position.
• Support strategic initiatives and M&A activity by providing capital impact assessments and scenario modelling as required.
• Contribute to wind-down planning and recovery analysis, ensuring capital and liquidity adequacy under stress is well-evidenced and clearly documented.
Key Deliverables & Outcomes
• An ICARA process and document that is robust, well-governed, and consistently meets FCA expectations.
• Capital models and quantitative methodologies that are credible, well-documented, and subject to appropriate governance.
• Regulatory submissions of the highest quality, produced on time and to standard.
• A stress testing programme that provides genuine insight into IG's capital resilience across a range of scenarios.
• Strong, trusted relationships with Finance enabling integrated and forward-looking capital planning.
• Clear, actionable capital adequacy MI that supports informed decision-making at committee and Board level.
What you'll need:
Professional Experience
• Significant experience in prudential risk, capital management, or a related quantitative risk discipline within financial services, gained in a second-line, regulatory, or specialist advisory capacity.
• Deep, hands-on knowledge of MIFIDPRU and the ICARA process, including capital adequacy assessment, wind-down analysis, and stress testing.
• Proven track record of developing and maintaining capital models and quantitative risk methodologies, with strong model governance practices.

Job Description
About the role
We are looking for a curious and thoughtful UX Researcher with strong foundations in social or behavioural science. This role is well suited to someone who wants to apply rigorous research to complex, real-world problems and grow their career in applied UX research.
You may already have some experience in UX or product research. Equally, you may be completing a PhD, working in academia, government, policy, behavioural research or another applied research environment and looking to move into industry.
What matters most is how you think: asking good questions, challenging assumptions, evaluating evidence critically, designing thoughtful research and turning complex findings into a clear point of view.
What you'll do
Frame complex problems
•
Work with stakeholders to turn broad product or business questions into clear, answerable research questions.
•
Identify assumptions, gaps in knowledge and areas of uncertainty before recommending new research.
•
Review existing evidence and understand user behaviour within its wider social, organisational and technological context.
•
Look beyond individual features to understand workflows, systems and broader patterns.
Design and conduct rigorous research
•
Select research methods that fit the question and the decision being made.
•
Plan and conduct qualitative research such as interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, field research and usability studies.
•
Design studies that consider bias, validity, ethics and the limitations of the available evidence.
•
Adapt research approaches to complex environments and populations that may be difficult to access.
•
Use quantitative approaches where appropriate, including surveys, structured studies and analysis of behavioural or product data to help answer research questions and measure user outcomes.
•
Partner with other researchers and specialists when a project requires different methodological expertise.
Make sense of evidence
•
Analyse qualitative data systematically and identify meaningful patterns.
•
Analyse and interpret quantitative data alongside qualitative findings, identifying patterns and relationships while being clear about sample size, uncertainty and the limitations of the evidence.
•
Distinguish between evidence, interpretation and assumption.
•
Connect individual findings to broader product, user and strategic questions.
Influence decisions
•
Translate research findings into clear implications and recommendations.
•
Communicate complex ideas in simple, accessible ways for multidisciplinary and senior audiences.
•
Help Product and Design teams understand how evidence should influence priorities and decisions.
•
Work collaboratively with stakeholders while maintaining an independent research perspective.
•
Contribute to the research community
•
Share methods, learning and evidence with other researchers.
•
Contribute to reusable research knowledge rather than treating every project as an isolated study.
•
Participate in critique, peer review and research planning.
•
Develop your own methodological expertise through coaching, collaboration and practice.
Basic Requirements
What we're looking for
We are particularly interested in candidates with a background in social or behavioural science and strong evidence of critical thinking. You should be able to demonstrate:
•
Strong research and analytical skills.
•
Experience designing and conducting empirical research.
•
The ability to take an ambiguous problem and break it into answerable questions.
•
Strong critical-thinking skills and a willingness to question assumptions.
•
The ability to evaluate the quality, strength and limitations of evidence.
•
Experience analysing qualitative research systematically.
•
The ability to identify patterns across complex or sometimes contradictory information.
•
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
•
The ability to explain research clearly to people without a research background.
•
Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding human behaviour.
•
Comfort working independently while collaborating closely with others.
•
A willingness to learn new research methods and work across different problem spaces.
Academic background
A postgraduate qualification in a relevant social or behavioural science is preferred. We would particularly welcome applications from candidates with a PhD, or equivalent research experience.
Relevant disciplines may include:
•
Psychology, sociology, anthropology or behavioural science
•
Cognitive science, Human-Computer Interaction or Human Factors
•
Criminology, public policy, political or social science
•
Education, organisational psychology or occupational psychology
•
Science and Technology Studies or another empirical social-science discipline
Your exact discipline matters less than the research skills and way of thinking you have developed through it.
Quantitative research
Quantitative research experience is desirable, but not essential. We are interested in candidates who are curious about developing mixed-methods capability and using qualitative and quantitative evidence together.
Useful experience could include:
•
Survey design and analysis
•
Experimental or quasi-experimental research
•
Statistical analysis or quantitative usability research
•
Behavioural or product-usage data
•
Data visualisation or working with structured datasets
•
Tools such as R, Python, SPSS, SQL or similar
•
We are not looking for a statistician or data scientist. Candidates with strong research foundations and an interest in learning will have opportunities to develop deeper quantitative and mixed-methods expertise within the team.
How research works at Motorola Solutions
Our researchers work across different kinds of questions. Some work closely with a product domain, building a deep understanding of its users, workflows and technology. Analog Design Intern – CSS Power Management
Location: Edinburgh, Scotland
Job Description
Analog Devices is seeking an Analog Design Intern – Power Management to join our engineering team in Edinburgh.
The successful candidate will join a collaborative team developing advanced low-power analog and power-management IP for highly integrated mixed-signal ICs. Working alongside experienced analog, mixed-signal and power-management engineers, the intern will contribute to real IC development activities while gaining practical experience in circuit architecture, transistor-level design, modelling, simulation and verification.
The team develops power-management solutions with a strong focus on low-power operation, high efficiency and small solution size. Key areas include switched-mode DC/DC converters such as buck, boost and buck-boost architectures, together with the analog building blocks required for their control, monitoring and protection.
This internship provides an opportunity to apply university knowledge to real silicon designs and develop an understanding of the complete IC development process, from architecture and modelling through circuit implementation, physical design, verification and potentially silicon evaluation.
Responsibilities
• Conduct circuit architecture research and feasibility studies for low-power power-management functions.
• Contribute to the architecture, design, simulation and verification of DC/DC converter IP, including buck, boost and buck-boost topologies.
• Design and analyse analog sub-circuits used within power converters, potentially including error amplifiers, comparators, voltage/current references, oscillators, gate drivers, level shifters, current-sensing circuits and protection functions.
• Develop simulation testbenches and contribute to design verification across process, voltage, temperature and operating-load conditions.
• Analyse important converter performance trade-offs including efficiency, quiescent current, transient response, output ripple, stability, silicon area and external component requirements.
• Explore different converter operating modes and control techniques to optimise efficiency across load conditions.
• Contribute to behavioural and system-level modelling to evaluate converter architectures and control-loop performance.
• Work closely with layout engineers during physical implementation, including review of parasitic effects and layout-dependent performance.
• Participate in technical and design reviews with experienced analog and power-management engineers.
• Support top-level integration and verification of power-management IP within larger mixed-signal systems.
• Where appropriate, contribute to laboratory evaluation and comparison of simulated and measured silicon performance.
Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a BEng, MEng, MSc or PhD in Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics or a closely related discipline.
• Good understanding of fundamental analog electronics and circuit theory.
• Understanding of CMOS devices and basic transistor-level circuit operation.
• Familiarity with feedback systems, frequency response and stability.
• Basic understanding of power electronics and switching circuits.
• Some experience with circuit simulation or electronic design tools through university, personal or industry projects.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good written and verbal communication skills.
• Enthusiasm for learning and working collaboratively within an engineering team.
Preferred Qualifications
• Understanding of DC/DC converter architectures, particularly buck, boost or buck-boost converters.
• Familiarity with concepts such as PWM/PFM operation, feedback control, loop stability and transient response.
• Familiarity with transistor-level IC design and tools such as Cadence Virtuoso and Spectre.
• Exposure to power-converter modelling or simulation using tools such as SIMPLIS, MATLAB or Simulink.
• Understanding of common power-management building blocks such as LDOs, voltage/current references, comparators, oscillators, current sensing and gate drivers.
• Familiarity with low-power circuit-design techniques and quiescent-current optimisation.
• Experience using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads and signal generators.
• Programming or scripting experience using Python, MATLAB or similar tools for modelling, simulation or data analysis.
• A strong interest in analog IC design, power management and energy-efficient electronic systems.

Job Description: Equipment Engineer Wafer Fab and Epitaxy (Continental Shift)
Location: Caswell, Northamptonshire

About Lumentum
Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) is a global leader in innovative optical and photonic products enabling optical networking and commercial laser customers worldwide. Our technologies are integral to virtually every type of telecom, enterprise, and data centre network, and support advanced manufacturing and next generation sensing applications. Lumentum’s UK wafer fabrication facility in Caswell is a centre of excellence for high-performance optoelectronic devices used in telecommunications and industrial systems.
Role Summary
As an Equipment Technician, you will provide technical support for the operation and maintenance of wafer fabrication and epitaxy equipment on a continental shift pattern. This role offers the opportunity to work on advanced III-V semiconductor technologies within a highly specialised UK fabrication facility, supporting products deployed globally in next-generation communications networks. Your primary focus will be the fault diagnosis, repair, and optimisation of advanced semiconductor process tools including vacuum, pneumatic, mechanical, electrical, and RF systems, as well as equipment handling hazardous process gases and chemicals.
This is a hands-on, high-precision engineering role ideal for those with experience maintaining complex electro-mechanical systems in critical environments including high-tech manufacturing, aerospace, defence, or UK Armed Forces technical trades.
Key Responsibilities
• Provide rapid first-line engineering response to minimise tool downtime and production impact.
• Conduct repairs, fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance on semiconductor processing equipment including, but not limited to lithography, etch, PVD, PECVD and MOVPE reactor systems.
• Manage chemical and specialty gas supply systems in compliance with statutory, site safety and environmental standards.
• Support maintenance of gas delivery, exhaust and abatement systems associated with epitaxy and PECVD tools.
• Manage spare parts inventory to ensure availability of critical components and minimise downtime.
• Implement and support preventative maintenance strategies to maximise OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) and uptime.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives (Kaizen, 6S, 8D) and maintain accurate documentation of actions and outcomes.
• Participate in production and planning meetings to represent equipment engineering performance.
• Support the site emergency response function including participation in the Site Emergency Response Team.
• Fork-lift truck operation will be required (training will be provided).
Key Relationships
• Process and Equipment Engineering Teams
• Facilities and Maintenance Teams
• Manufacturing Operations Team
• MES (PROMIS) and IT Teams
Qualifications
Apprenticeship, HNC, HND or Degree in an Electrical or Mechanical Engineering discipline (or equivalent). Alternatively, a minimum of 5 years’ directly relevant experience in complex electro-mechanical system maintenance.
Preferred Backgrounds and Transferable Skills
We actively welcome applications from engineers with experience in high-reliability environments such as aerospace, defence, automotive manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, power generation, or UK Armed Forces technical trades. Direct semiconductor experience is advantageous but not essential.
Skills
Essential:
• Proven experience in a high-tech, precision-engineering environment.
• Strong fault-finding and diagnostic ability across electrical, electronic and mechanical systems.
• Ability to work safely with hazardous gases and chemicals.
• Ability to follow detailed documented procedures with minimal supervision.
• Competence in documenting procedures, risk assessments, and method statements.
• Effective time management and organisational skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
• Team-oriented approach with excellent communication skills.
• Ability to read and interpret technical documentation and communicate effectively within a safety-critical manufacturing environment.
Desirable:
• Previous experience within a semiconductor or cleanroom manufacturing environment.
Other Requirements

• Work is performed within a cleanroom environment (cleanroom garments provided).
• Role requires use of Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA). Candidates must be able to meet the medical and respiratory protective equipment (RPE) face-fit requirements associated with SCBA use in accordance with site safety standards.

The Team:
Portfolio Valuations (PV) provides an independent, post-trade valuation service to buy-side institutions globally, covering vanilla and exotic OTC derivatives, cash instruments and structured notes across all asset classes. The service also enables clients to receive an aggregated set of counterparty marks for their trades.
You will join a collaborative team of analysts responsible for creating, maintaining and delivering high-quality derivatives market datasets and valuations. The team works closely across functions and regions, with a shared focus on accuracy, client service and continuous improvement.
The Impact:
In this role, you will help ensure that clients receive accurate, timely and reliable OTC derivative valuations and market data. Your work will support daily and monthly valuation processes, strengthen quality controls and contribute to the development of valuation products and systems.
The position offers the opportunity to deepen your derivatives knowledge across asset classes, build commercial and client-facing skills, and understand how your work contributes to the team’s broader goals and service quality.

• Organize and run daily and monthly client valuation processes, taking hands-on responsibility for assigned accounts.
• Investigate and resolve straightforward and complex price challenges, using market data and valuation analysis to reach clear, well-supported outcomes for clients.

• Contribute to the design, testing and ongoing improvement of S&P Global valuation systems and new products, bringing forward practical ideas and solutions.
• Build and maintain effective client relationships; host client calls, present the Portfolio Valuations service, act as an escalation contact, and review and resolve incidents.

• A client-service mindset and the confidence to communicate with external clients regularly by email, phone and in meetings.

• Clear, structured and professional written and verbal communication, with active participation in team discussions and collaborative work.

Additional Preferred Qualifications
• Relevant practical experience in derivative pricing, valuations, market data or a related financial-services environment.
• Programming or querying experience in a language such as SQL or Python.

Job Description:
The Lead Payroll Specialist will be a local representative of the Payroll Department supporting Abercrombie & Fitch stores in the United Kingdom.  In this role, the Lead Payroll Specialist supports payroll and compliance processes and procedures.  The payroll auditor is also the main point of contact for both associate inquiries, as well as third party communication.  The Lead Payroll Specialist is also responsible for researching and resolving any changes and/or issues in accordance with local laws.
This position will report directly to an EMEA Payroll Sr. Manager and will be located in our London office.
What will you be doing?
• Perform end-to-end payroll validation, including pre- and post-payroll audits, variance analysis, and reconciliation of payroll outputs to ensure accuracy and completeness.
• Leverage data analysis (e.g., Excel, reporting tools) to identify trends, discrepancies, and improvement opportunities across payroll processes.
• Act as a subject matter expert for payroll and HR systems (e.g., ADP GlobalView, Workday), supporting issue resolution, data integrity, and continuous improvement.
• Support payroll-related projects and system implementations, including process changes, testing (UAT), and go-live activities.
• Ensure alignment with internal audit requirements, and company policies, identifying, and mitigating payroll risks.
• Maintain and update payroll procedures and documentation to ensure consistency, compliance, and knowledge sharing across the team.
• Take ownership of complex payroll issues, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate escalation when required.
• Support additional EMEA payrolls as needed, ensuring alignment with regional standards and practices
What will you need to bring?
• Completed Bachelor's degree, four-year equivalent, and/or finished apprenticeship
• 4+ years United Kingdom Payroll experience.
• Proficient in country laws pertaining to payroll, including, but not limited to: tax, social insurance, work rules, and statutory reporting.  Understanding of local custom vs. local requirements, and ability to take the needs of the business into consideration.
• Ability to execute tasks and meet critical deadlines in a thorough, poised, accurate, and timely manner, while managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced and often-changing environment.
• Superior customer service delivery when communicating with associates and resolving payroll concerns.  Ability to balance timely resolution with quality responses; demonstrating empathy in all associate-driven communication.
• Actively and thoroughly investigates payroll issues and/or changes and actions them appropriately.
• Communicates in a highly effective, yet approachable manner; able to communicate with all levels of the business.  Timely and appropriate escalation of payroll issues to supervisor.
• High level of attention to detail and meticulous follow-through, coupled with the flexibility to shift requirements and expectations, due to ever-changing needs of the business.
• A collaborative approach to work; builds strong partnerships with business partners.
• Self-motivated, self-starting, and creative thinker; shows resiliency in problem-solving.
• Able to work with highly confidential payroll and compensation data, including sensitive financial information, demonstrating integrity, discretion, and professionalism, with the ability to remain objective and unbiased
• Experience using Workday is desirable.
• Previous experience leading or supervising payroll specialists is preferred.
Company Description
Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.
The company operates a family of brands, including Abercrombie brands and Hollister brands, each sharing a commitment to offer products of enduring quality and exceptional comfort that support global customers on their journey to being and becoming who they are. Abercrombie & Fitch Co. operates stores under these brands across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East, as well as the e-commerce sites abercrombie.com, abercrombiekids.com and hollisterco.com.
Learn more about A&F Co. by visiting our corporate website here.

Copart are looking to recruit a collaborative and ROI focussed Digital Marketing Executive to join our Marketing team, based at our Head Office in Bedford, MK43 9EJ. (Due to the location of the office, you must have access to a vehicle)
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing Copart’s social media channels across its portfolio of brands, ensuring engaging and consistent content that supports the company’s social media presence.
This is a hands-on, commercially focused role that goes beyond content creation and publishing. You will be responsible for campaign delivery, performance analysis and optimisation, as well as contributing to digital projects that support our wider marketing objectives. You will manage organic and paid social media activity, creating engaging content and campaigns that build brand awareness, drive engagement and generate conversions across the marketing funnel.
The ideal candidate will have strong social media expertise, a good understanding of the wider digital marketing landscape, and the ability to use data and insights to improve performance.
If you have a passion for social media, digital marketing and can interpret data to insights, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.
Main Responsibilities:
• Manage the implementation of the social media strategy, from planning and execution through to measurement and optimisation, ensuring best practice in content creation and distribution across Copart’s portfolio of brands.
• Plan, schedule, and publish engaging organic social media content to grow our audience, strengthen brand awareness and encourage customer engagement.
• Manage and optimise paid social media campaigns to reach target audiences, support objectives across the marketing funnel and drive conversions.
• Analyse social media performance using analytics tools, assessing engagement, campaign effectiveness, and ROI to identify opportunities for improvement and inform future strategy.
• Ensure all social media communications align with our brand positioning and messaging, working with relevant teams to maintain a consistent brand presence across channels.
• Stay up to date with social media trends, platform developments, and competitor activity to identify opportunities to improve performance and enhance our social media presence.
• Support wider digital marketing projects, including website content management and CMS updates, drawing on a broad understanding of digital channels and platforms.
• Manage digital projects end to end, coordinating with relevant teams to ensure projects are delivered effectively, on time and in line with business objectives.
What we need from you:
• Demonstrable experience managing organic and paid social media channels, developing engaging content and delivering campaigns that support business objectives.
• A strong understanding of the wider digital marketing mix, with the ability to support website content management, CMS updates and other digital marketing activities.
• Experience managing digital projects from inception through to delivery, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring projects are delivered on time and to the required standard.
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret digital performance data, measure campaign effectiveness and use insights to inform future strategy and optimisation.
• Excellent planning, organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads, manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build productive relationships with internal teams, agencies and external suppliers.
• Excellent reporting and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate performance, insights and recommendations clearly.
• A proactive approach to keeping up to date with social media trends, platform developments and digital marketing best practice.
• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work effectively under pressure and within budget.
• A degree or professional qualification in Marketing or Digital Marketing, such as CIM, is desirable.
What we offer you in return:
• Time For You: Relax with 23 days of holiday plus bank holidays, and an extra day for a personal special occasion.
• Give Back: Receive a paid day to volunteer for a charity of your choice.
• Health & Wellness: Healthcare Cash Plan.
• Your Future: Join our contributory workplace pension scheme for financial security.
• Investment: Purchase shares in our global company at a discounted rate.
• Fitness & Health: Save money while commuting with our Cycle to Work Scheme and access fitness videos and gym discounts.
• Life Assurance: Enjoy peace of mind with our life insurance coverage.
• Exclusive Discounts: Access our deals hub for savings on everyday purchases and family activities.

By embracing diverse perspectives, we open doors to innovation and unleash the full potential of our team. LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.
About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.
What the Role Entails
1. Game Co-dev Coordination & Resource Alignment: Align, identify, and sort out game product and technical requirements across diverse co-development partners, external game studios, and internal development teams; coordinate global resources to ensure clear scope boundaries and shared ownership.
2. Cross-region Game Milestone & Delivery Management: Formulate, track, and synchronize master project plans across different time zones and regions; manage the delivery pipeline of game assets (Art, Animation, Audio) and code integration to ensure multi-site milestones are met on time.
3. Cross-cultural Game Workflow & Standardization: Establish, optimize, and promote standard remote-collaboration workflows and communication protocols to bridge cultural gaps and language barriers, ensuring efficient game asset handovers and review processes.
4.Distributed Team Risk & Conflict Management: Proactively identify and solve project bottlenecks unique to distributed game development (e.g., communication lag, build integration friction, cultural mismatches) to minimize project risks and maintain alignment.
5. Game Industry & Tech Trend Research: Conduct deep-dive market and desk research on global gaming industries and emerging technology trends (including but not limited to Generative AI, AI-driven game development tools, and innovative gameplay metrics), delivering actionable insight reports.
Who We Look For
1. Global Mindset & Cross-cultural Communication: Exceptional cross-cultural communication, interpersonal, and translation/documentation skills; ability to comfortably collaborate with diverse stakeholders from different cultural and game development backgrounds.
2. Distributed Game Project Management: Solid understanding of the game development lifecycle (GDLC), with practical experience or strong knowledge in distributed/remote team management, art outsourcing coordination, or multi-site agile frameworks.
3. Game Research & Analytical Skills: Strong desk research capabilities with a high sensitivity to game market trends; familiar with AI toolsets (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Copilot) and how they apply to gaming tech or productivity improvement.
4. Language & Time-zone Adaptability: Proficient in English (and other languages depending on region) as a working language; high flexibility to work across different time zones to align with global game studios.
5. Preferred Qualifications: Experience living/studying abroad, prior internship in an international game studio (PMO/Outsourcing/Localization), or a deep gamer with insights into various genres is highly preferred.
Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
Meet the team:
Strategy, Partnerships & Growth Enablement is the EMEA function where EMEA's next chapter gets built. Our region is moving from selling great technology to leading on outcomes — helping people act earlier, helping clinicians decide better, and helping health systems get more value. Channel is how that intent reaches real patients, at scale.

Distributor Manager - Channel Excellence EMEA is an execution-focused role responsible for translating agreed channel priorities into scalable governance, operational processes, distributor management routines, and performance visibility across EMEA. •
You bring strong channel management, distributor governance, commercial operations, or partner management capability in a regional or multi-market environment.
•
You can convert strategic priorities into clear operating processes, implementation tools, governance routines, and measurable execution plans.
•
You are confident working across matrixed teams and influencing without authority across Commercial, Finance, Legal, Analytics, Market Access, Marketing, and country stakeholders.
•
You manage complexity well, balancing partner performance, compliance requirements, operational readiness, and market-specific needs across diverse EMEA channel models.
•
You know which KPIs are important, how to interpret and to distill out meaningful insights. You are a proficient communicator of KPI derived insights enabling business decisions to be taken in a timely and impactful manner.

You have strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to create structure where processes are evolving or ambiguous.

You bring attention to detail and sound commercial judgement when assessing distributor capability, operational maturity, compliance readiness, and strategic fit.

Your experience in medical technology, healthcare, pharmacy, retail, distributor, or indirect-market environments is an advantage.

A full and comprehensive benefits program.

The Role
This is a high-impact, hands-on role at the heart of our Systems Engineering team, serving as the vital link between prototype development and mission-ready product release. You will balance structured V-model verification with rapid "fail-fast" testing to ensure our world-class RF systems are robust, reliable, and technically superior. If you take pride in technical problem-solving and love the challenge of uncovering emergent issues in complex, integrated hardware and software, this is the role for you.

•
Verification Strategy: Define and execute system-level validation plans that balance rigorous testing with delivery speed to ensure risks are retired early in the development cycle.

Prototype Testing: Plan and conduct functional, performance, and stress testing in both lab and field environments to feed critical results back into design decisions.

System Integration: Validate complete systems, ensuring that integrated hardware, RF, software, and mechanical elements perform seamlessly as intended.
•
Fault-Finding & Root Cause: Lead investigations into complex technical issues across multiple domains, supporting fault-finding from the embedded level to mechanical integration.
•
Infrastructure Improvement: Develop and maintain high-quality test rigs, fixtures, and automated procedures to improve the repeatability and efficiency of our validation activities.
•
Documentation & Reporting: Produce clear, evidence-based documentation that supports technical reviews, NPI handover, and engineering changes.

•
Experience: A proven background in the test, validation, or integration of complex RF or electronics-based systems, preferably within an NPI or R&D environment.
•
Technical Proficiency: Expert hands-on experience using diagnostic tools like spectrum analysers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes to measure and verify RF performance.
•
Diagnostic Skills: A methodical approach to troubleshooting integrated hardware/software issues, with a proactive ability to operate as a "devil's advocate" during the design phase.
•
Educational Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

Mindset: A practical, evidence-driven professional who is comfortable working with imperfect prototypes and can balance delivery pace with verification confidence.

Based at our state-of-the-art facility in Cambridge (Bourn Quarter), you will join a collaborative and high-energy engineering team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of spectrum intelligence. This is a full-time, hands-on role where your expertise directly influences our next-generation products and ensures that CRFS continues to deliver industry-leading reliability. You will work at the cutting edge of RF innovation, moving between laboratory-based verification and field testing trials.

In return for your expertise, we’ll support your professional growth with personalised coaching and development every step of the way. To reward your hard work, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed for your financial, physical, and personal well-being:

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.

Working within multidisciplinary teams, the role applies scientific and engineering principles to resolve technical challenges, enhance process capability, and support new product development and customer requirements.
As part of the plasma dicing team, the primary responsibilities of this position include developing plasma etch processes, processing customer wafers using etch demonstration equipment, and documenting the completed sample processing activities.
Additional responsibilities include providing customer technical support, preparing technical reports for internal and external stakeholders, generating intellectual property submissions, and supporting other business units as required.
Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role to support customer installations and development activities. Process Demonstrations

• Assess results using analytical equipment and relevant software tools.
• Perform process troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
• Provide regular updates to Product Management on demonstration and sample work.
• Build and maintain effective relationships with customers and the global KLA support network.
• Summarise findings through technical reports and presentations.
Process Development
• Develop and optimise processes across SPTS product platforms.
• Plan and execute work safely, efficiently, and to agreed timescales.
• Utilise endpoint detection techniques to enhance process control and performance.
• Conduct long-duration testing for new processes and equipment.
• Contribute to cross-functional projects supporting new products and technologies.
• Prepare technical reports to support patent applications, publications, and conferences.
Field Support
• Develop and optimise SPTS processes to meet customer requirements at customer sites.
• Provide factory-based technical support to field teams and customers.
• Establish and maintain strong customer relationships through effective technical support.
Qualifications and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
• A PhD, Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, together with relevant industrial experience. Candidates with equivalent qualifications and hands-on semiconductor process engineering experience are also encouraged to apply.
• Experience of plasma etch processing within a semiconductor environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience with semiconductor metrology techniques.
• SEM experience would be advantageous, although training can be provided.
• Knowledge and practical experience of endpoint detection techniques.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• The ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
• Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
What We Offer

• Share scheme
• Contributory pension scheme
• Cash health plan
• Cycle to Work scheme
• Global bonus plan
• Employee rewards scheme
• Life assurance
Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role to support customer installations and development activities. Occasional shift work may also be required. Job Title
Europe & Middle East Content Localisation manager
Job Description
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions — built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
The bar is high — bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG — the future gets built here.
Your team
Organic search is a core growth channel for IG. Our SEO team is responsible for making sure investors can find us, trust us and start their journey with us, and as we expand our presence across Europe, our websites are central to that. You'll join the team at an important moment, as we build out a dedicated European web presence and the content engine to go with it.
About this role
We're looking for a European Content & Localisation Manager to own how IG's content performs across our European& Middle Easr websites. You will decide what content is translated, what is tailored for a market and what is created locally, prioritise that work by search opportunity, and make sure it ranks and converts. You will also project-manage the content workstream of our migration to a new European website.
This role is based in our London office and reports into the SEO Lead. You will work day to day with our content editor and with Marketing, Compliance and commercial stakeholders, and alongside MarTech, who own the technical side of the migration. You'll be the person who thinks about our European websites as a whole: which content is relevant for which market, what can simply be translated, what needs real adaptation, and what to do first.
This is not a traditional SEO or editorial role. SEO experience is a plus, but what matters most is sound commercial judgement, strong project management and excellent language skills. Fluency in French or German is essential. We operate in a regulated industry, so experience in finance is a big plus.
What you'll do
• Own the European content roadmap, prioritising what gets localised, tailored or created by market based on search opportunity, commercial value and effort.
• Decide for each piece of content whether to translate, adapt or create locally, and set clear standards so these decisions are consistent and repeatable.
• Work with the content editor and other stakeholders to identify the content from our existing English-language library that is most relevant to European audiences, and bring it to market quickly.
• Manage translation partners and AI-assisted translation workflows, and act as the quality owner for French or German content, making sure tone, terminology and regulatory wording are right.
• Partner with Compliance to build a clear, efficient review process so content meets the requirements of each market without slowing us down.
• Project-manage the content workstream of the migration to our European website, including content inventory and audit, URL and content mapping, prioritisation, QA and launch checks, working with MarTech and the SEO Lead on technical delivery.
• Monitor and report on the search performance of European content, including rankings, organic traffic and conversions, and turn the findings into clear recommendations and priorities.
• Work with Marketing, Product and in-market stakeholders to make sure European content supports campaigns, launches and customer needs.
• Build clear documentation, templates and playbooks so the localisation process can scale across markets and languages.
• Find ways to help the team move faster and operate more strategically as a growth engine for IG. Curiosity with AI is a must.
What success looks like
• A clear, prioritised European content roadmap that stakeholders understand and support
• Migration content workstream delivered on time, with search visibility protected through the transition
• Measurable growth in organic traffic and conversions across priority European markets
• A well-documented, efficient localisation process with consistent quality and compliance sign-off
• High-quality French or German content that reads as if it was written locally
What you'll need for this role
• Fluent or native French or German, with excellent written and spoken English
• Proven experience in content, localisation, editorial or digital marketing roles, with a track record of delivering content at scale
• Strong project management skills, with experience delivering cross-functional projects to deadlines
• Commercial and data-led judgement, comfortable using performance data to prioritise and make decisions
• Strong stakeholder management and an ownership mindset, able to influence without direct authority
• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to deliver accurately at pace
• Curiosity about AI and how it can improve translation, content and reporting workflows
Nice to haves:
• Working knowledge of SEO, including keyword research, on-page optimisation and search performance reporting
• Experience with website migrations or replatforming
• Experience in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry
• Experience working with a CMS and with translation management tools or vendors
• Additional European languages, such as Spanish, Italian or Dutch
The perks:
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
• Competitive salary
• Flexible Benefits Package on top of your salary (12%)
• Private medical cover for you and your family
• Life insurance
• Contribution to gym memberships
• 25 days holiday, with 1 additional day off to celebrate your Birthday & 2 additional days off a year for voluntary work (28 in total)
• The option to buy or sell holiday days
